summary: Investigated unexpected operator notifications and verified a pytest environment-isolation defect: tests and subprocesses inherited live Telegram configuration from the invoking shell, allowing synthetic report finalizations to reach the operator channel. Added a test-wide external-notification isolation boundary with explicit governed live-test opt-in. Production notification behavior, PFN-001, and exactly-once logical completion are unchanged. Repository evidence identifies eight synthetic local notification events in the incident window but cannot reconstruct the exact external count because no durable per-attempt Telegram receipt ledger exists.
